title: result.backgroundTasks lists engine-backgrounded work only and never a subagent: with an in-flight subagent and an in-flight shell task, only the shell task is reported, and with an in-flight subagent alone the signal is absent rather than empty. Entries supplied by the engine are classified through the same task-kind mapping that routes the event families, so a friendly 'subagent' label is dropped and 'local_bash' is normalized to 'shell'.
